findings.title: Pagination computes an extra page for exact page-size member counts
findings.body: `totalPages` uses `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which produces one extra page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, a group with 50 members and a limit of 50 displays page 1/2 and enables Next; clicking it requests offset 50 and displays an empty page. Use a ceiling calculation (for example, `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`) instead.

findings.title: Public group member pages now silently truncate groups to 50 members
findings.body: The route now calls the paginated `Group#findMembers`, whose default limit is 50, but the public `group/members` template has no pagination controls or mechanism to request later offsets. Consequently, visiting the members page for any group with more than 50 users only shows the first 50 users. Previously non-automatic groups returned their complete membership list (and automatic groups used a 200-member limit). Add public pagination/infinite loading or preserve a complete list for this view.
